failure.execution: The agent could not run, so nothing was verified.
failure.verification: The agent ran; its result did not pass verification.
failure.verification_unavailable: A verification command could not run, so the outcome is unknown.
failure.interrupted: Atomic Chat stopped while this run was in progress; its outcome is unknown.

task.title: Task
task.description: What every agent is asked to do, and how the result is verified. ★ marks the bundled benchmark.
task.fixture: Fresh copy of the bundled {{fixture}} fixture for every run
task.heldOut: Held-out checks ({{set}}) are written into the copy just before verification.
task.snapshot: Fresh copy of commit {{commit}} of {{repo}} for every run

run.title: Run
run.description: Each selected agent runs the task once, one run at a time, then the task's verification decides the outcome.
run.notInstalled: Not installed — install it from the Launch page
run.claudeUsesLocal: Use the Local API Server and the model below (otherwise Claude Code's own configuration)
run.modelPlaceholder: Model served by the Local API Server
run.serverStopped: The Local API Server is stopped; it is started when a run needs it.

history.title: Run history
history.description: Every run is kept across restarts. Tick runs to compare them.

detail.title: Run details
detail.notActive: This run is not running in this session.
detail.reviewPrompt: Review the result, then record your judgment.
detail.reviewExtra: Add your own judgment. It is kept beside the verified outcome and does not change it.
detail.agentReport: Agent's own report (its claims, not evidence)
detail.changesIncomplete: The project has more files than were compared; the lists are incomplete.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.differentTasks: These runs did different tasks; their results are not comparable.

editor.name: Name
editor.projectFolderHint: The agent works in this folder and its changes are kept. Use a copy or a clean git checkout.
editor.projectFixtureHint: Every run gets its own fresh copy, so nothing else is touched.
editor.commandsHint: Run after the agent, in the project folder, without a shell. Each passes when it exits 0.
editor.heldOut: Held-out checks from the bundled benchmark ({{set}}) stay attached.
editor.projectSnapshotHint: Every run gets a fresh copy of the tracked files of this commit, without credential-shaped files. The repository is never changed.

stop.process_end: When the agent process ended ({{detail}}); the agent recorded no trajectory

inspector.title: Run inspector
inspector.diagnosisHint: Candidate causes from deterministic rules over the recorded evidence, and from reviewers. None of them is a fact; each names its source, confidence and evidence.
inspector.noUnknowns: Nothing the rules know to be missing.
inspector.suggestions: Suggestions (proposed, not evidence; never used by the rules)
inspector.timelineHint: Only what was recorded, in order. Missing entries mark evidence this run does not have.
inspector.repliesHint: What the model said, as the agent printed it. Claims, not evidence.
inspector.noTrace: the agent's evidence was not captured for this run

regression.title: Create a regression task
regression.preserved: The original task and run stay exactly as they are.
regression.sameBaseline: Every run of the new task starts from the same baseline as the original.
regression.snapshotClean: The project was clean at commit {{commit}}: the regression runs on a fresh snapshot of that commit.
regression.snapshotUnavailable: The project was not a clean git repository at the start, so its start cannot be reproduced; the regression runs on the project in place, and the task records that limitation.
regression.descriptionPlaceholder: In your own words: what the agent did and why it is wrong
regression.descriptionReference: In your own words. The rules said: {{summary}}
regression.improvementPlaceholder: What you would change in the agent, and how this task should then behave
regression.expectSuccess: Success: every check passes once fixed
regression.failed: Could not create the regression task

suites.title: Regression suites
suites.description: Pinned tasks with expected outcomes, run against one agent and model configuration and compared with an earlier run.
suites.empty: No tasks yet. Pick a task on the Runs tab, then add it here.
suites.label: Label, e.g. baseline or after-fix
suites.runHint: Uses the model and settings from the Runs tab. Each task runs at its pinned version, one at a time.
suites.notComparable: Not directly comparable — these conditions differ:
suites.duration: Duration {{total}} over {{recorded}} of {{count}} runs with a recorded time

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: What to fix next: unsuccessful runs grouped by their primary cause, with the evidence behind it.
failures.totals: {{considered}} runs: {{failed}} failed or inconclusive, {{succeeded}} succeeded, {{excluded}} cancelled or unfinished (excluded)
failures.hint: Each failed run counts once, by its primary cause; contributing causes are counted apart. Categories are candidates from the rules or reviewers, not facts.
